message.content: {"cvss_vector":"CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:P/VC:H/VI:H/VA:N/SC:N/SI:H/SA:N","aivss":{"LC":"I","CP":"C","AP":"C","RH":"P","ES":"W"},"rationales":{"LC":"Attacker-controlled text from a fetched page (data/web/poisoned_memory.txt:5) reaches the remember tool and is later replayed as trusted instructions in the system prompt (memory.py:72-79, loop.py:17-25), so language influences security-relevant behaviour through ingested content.","CP":"The poisoned rule is written to the durable long-term memory file (memory.py:60-66, config.py:15) and remains reachable in later sessions with no expiry (memory.py:1-7), which is cross-session memory rather than mere re-retrieval.","AP":"The stored note relays from the memory component into the system prompt and then into send_email within the same single agent, principal and policy domain (loop.py:17-25, tools.py:263-272); no trust boundary is crossed.","RH":"The agent can reach a reward/instruction channel it treats as authoritative — its own memory replayed as trusted orders (memory.py:72-79) — and no verified reward-hacking episode is reported, so the proxy is reachable with zero verified episodes.","ES":"The baseline offers all twelve built-in tools with no argument validation (tools.py:20-99, tools.py:235-238) and re-fetches and trusts an unpinned remote MCP manifest each run (mcp_client.py:1-4, loop.py:35-37), so reachable extensions are dynamic and unvetted.","CVSS":"The attacker is a page author whose text reaches the model through fetch_url, a remote network source (tools.py:312-325), and the user must fetch the page and later ask for the email (UI:P); the agent runs with one identity and no authentication on tools (tools.py:226-258), so PR:N.
